title: Step-Driven First-Order Lag System
description: Closed-loop first-order thermal/electrical lag plant driven by a constant step reference through an error summing junction, inverse time-constant gain, integrator state, and output scope.

title: PI-Controlled DC Motor Speed Loop
description: Closed-loop DC servo motor speed regulator combining proportional and integral control paths with armature inertia integration and viscous damping feedback.

title: Van der Pol Nonlinear Oscillator
description: Second-order Van der Pol relaxation oscillator implemented with dual state integrators, nonlinear quadratic damping multiplier, and phase-plane output scopes.

title: Longitudinal Aircraft Pitch Autopilot
description: Short-period longitudinal aircraft pitch attitude hold autopilot with inner pitch-rate damper loop, outer pitch-angle tracker, elevator actuator lag, and a companion MATLAB gain initialization script.

files.init_gains.m:
% Longitudinal Aircraft Pitch Autopilot Gain Initialization
% Cruise condition: Mach 0.78, Altitude 10,000 m
Kp_theta = 4.5;     % Outer-loop pitch attitude gain [rad/rad]
Kq_damper = 1.2;    % Inner-loop pitch rate damper gain [s]
M_de = 3.8;         % Elevator control effectiveness [1/s^2]
theta_cmd = 0.10;   % Commanded pitch step [rad] (~5.7 deg)

title: Cascade FOC PMSM Electric Drive with Inverter Subsystem
description: Field-Oriented Control (FOC) permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) cascade drive with outer speed loop, inner q-axis current loop, companion referenced inverter subsystem, and motor parameter script.

files.motor_params.m:
% 80 kW Traction PMSM Motor & SiC Inverter Parameters
Rs = 0.018;         % Stator phase resistance [Ohm]
Ld = 0.0022;        % d-axis inductance [H]
Lq = 0.0025;        % q-axis inductance [H]
Kt = 0.48;          % Torque constant [N*m/A]
J_rotor = 0.020;    % Rotor inertia [kg*m^2]
Vdc_nom = 400.0;    % DC link voltage [V]
f_sw = 20000.0;     % SiC PWM switching frequency [Hz]
